text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu participating in summer 
training camp. Symboli Rudolf had also 
come to inspect the camp. To Symboli 
Rudolf, who had grown accustomed to 
management—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu seemed lost in thought. On 
the other hand, Mr. C.B. seemed to hold 
high expectations for Mejiro Ramonu's 
future success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a premonition that something is bound 
to happen, the summer training camp 
begins.
